title: Update booking form to match uploaded design format

requirements.text: Restructure the BookingSection form layout to match the uploaded design with a two-column grid for form fields, placing Customer/Consignor Name alongside Mobile Number, No. of Packages alongside Approximate Weight(Kg), Origin Pincode alongside Destination Pincode, Preferred Pickup Date alongside Email, and Address 1 spanning full width at the bottom

quotes: add this formate for booking form

acceptanceCriteria: Form fields are arranged in a two-column grid matching the uploaded design
Address 1 field spans the full width below the grid
Field labels match the uploaded design exactly

requirements.text: Add a Mode selector toggle at the top of the booking form with truck/ground and airplane/air shipping icons as radio button options, with the truck option selected by default
acceptanceCriteria: Mode selector appears at the top of the form with truck and airplane icons
Only one mode can be selected at a time
Truck/ground mode is selected by default
Selected mode is highlighted with a green indicator

requirements.text: Add Address 2 and Address 3 optional fields below Address 1, displayed in a two-column layout matching the design
acceptanceCriteria: Address 2 and Address 3 fields appear below Address 1
Both fields are optional and arranged in two columns
Field styling matches other form inputs

requirements.text: Add a Verify button next to the Mobile Number field for mobile number verification functionality
acceptanceCriteria: Verify button appears inline with Mobile Number field
Button has light gray background matching the design
Button is visually aligned with the input field

requirements.text: Update form field labels to match the uploaded design exactly: use 'Customer/Consignor Name', 'Mobile Number', 'No. of Packages', 'Approximate Weight(Kg)', 'Origin Pincode', 'Destination Pincode', 'Preferred Pickup Date', 'Email', 'Address 1', 'Address 2', and 'Address 3'
acceptanceCriteria: All field labels match the exact text from the uploaded design
Required field asterisks are positioned before the label text
Label styling is consistent across all fields

requirements.text: Replace the existing Select Shipping Option radio buttons with the Mode toggle selector at the top, and remove the separate Services selection from the form since shipping mode is now controlled by the toggle
acceptanceCriteria: Shipping option radio buttons are removed from the form
Mode toggle is the primary shipping method selector
Form submission correctly captures the selected mode

requirements.text: Add decorative package box illustrations in the bottom-right corner of the form matching the visual style shown in the uploaded design
acceptanceCriteria: Package box illustrations appear in the bottom-right corner
Illustrations do not overlap with form content
Visual style matches the uploaded design

requirements.text: Update the Preferred Pickup Date field to use a date-time picker input with a calendar icon button, displaying the format '19-02-2026 13:34 PM' as shown in the uploaded design
acceptanceCriteria: Date field includes a calendar icon button on the right
Date format displays as DD-MM-YYYY HH:MM AM/PM
Clicking the calendar icon opens a date-time picker

requirements.text: Add a green 'General' heading at the top of the booking form section to match the uploaded design
acceptanceCriteria: Green 'General' heading appears above the mode selector
Heading uses green color matching the design theme
Heading is center-aligned

constraints: Maintain the existing backend Booking data structure
Preserve all form validation logic including 6-digit pincode validation
Keep the existing booking confirmation dialog integration
Do not modify the BookingConfirmationDialog or ShippingLabel components
nonGoals: Implementing actual mobile number verification functionality
Adding backend changes for mode or additional address fields
Modifying the admin dashboard booking display
Changing the existing courier partners or services sections

required: Truck icon for ground shipping mode selector in green (truck-icon.dim_32x32.png)
Airplane icon for air shipping mode selector in green (airplane-icon.dim_32x32.png)
Decorative package box illustrations for form corner in warm colors (package-boxes.dim_400x200.png)
